description: Land Title Settlement Department - Udowita, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, including specific parcel numbers, land extents, and cadastral details. It involves calling for claims to property and the process of registering land titles under the Registration of Title Act, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
